title: WebPros security advisory (AV26-908)
description: As of September 10, 2026, WebPros is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
cPanel & WebHost Manager (WHM) software
	Prior to 11.110.0.143
Prior to 11.134.0.55
Prior to 11.136.0.39
Prior to 11.138.0.4
Prior to WP2: 11.138.1.9
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
